items.context: The description is 'A new test idea' which doesn't specify what problem is being solved or what value is delivered. We need a concrete description of what this idea is before any meaningful planning can happen.

options.label: A new standalone scenario/application
options.rationale: A self-contained app that provides a distinct capability, like existing scenarios (video-studio, dashboard, etc.)

options.label: An enhancement to an existing scenario
options.rationale: Adds new functionality to one of the existing Vrooli scenarios

options.label: A testing/infrastructure tool for Vrooli itself
options.rationale: Internal tooling that improves Vrooli's development, testing, or deployment capabilities

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Provide your own description of what this idea is

items.context: Understanding who will use this determines architecture, UX complexity, and deployment model. Vrooli scenarios can serve end users, developers, businesses, or internal Vrooli operations.

options.label: End users / consumers
options.rationale: Public-facing application with UI, needs polished UX and onboarding

options.label: Developers / technical users
options.rationale: API-first or CLI tool, can assume technical proficiency

options.label: Internal Vrooli operations
options.rationale: Supports Vrooli's recursive improvement loop, used by agents or maintainers

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Specify your target audience

items.context: Vrooli scenarios can include any combination of API, UI, and CLI. The component mix determines project structure, build tooling, and development effort.

options.label: API only (Go backend)
options.rationale: Lightweight service, no frontend needed — good for data processing, automation, or internal tools

options.label: API + UI (Go backend + React frontend)
options.rationale: Full-stack application with user-facing interface — most common pattern for end-user scenarios

options.label: API + CLI (Go backend + Go CLI)
options.rationale: Backend service with command-line interface — good for developer tools and automation

options.label: API + UI + CLI
options.rationale: Full suite — maximum flexibility but highest development effort

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Specify your preferred component mix

items.context: Vrooli provides shared local resources (postgres, redis, qdrant, ollama, etc.) that scenarios can compose. Choosing the right resources early informs architecture and service.json configuration.

options.label: PostgreSQL only
options.rationale: Standard relational storage — sufficient for most CRUD-oriented scenarios

options.label: PostgreSQL + Redis
options.rationale: Adds caching and pub/sub — good for real-time features or session management

options.label: PostgreSQL + Redis + Ollama
options.rationale: Adds local AI/LLM capabilities — needed for AI-powered features

options.label: None / minimal
options.rationale: Standalone service with no shared resource dependencies

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Specify your resource needs

items.topic: What file paths are expected to change?
items.context: The acceptance_allow field in spec.json is empty. Defining expected change boundaries helps with sandbox configuration and post-execution validation. This should be set before any implementation work begins.

options.label: Broad scenario-level globs (e.g., scenarios/new-test-idea/**)
options.rationale: Covers all files in a new standalone scenario directory

options.label: Targeted subdirectory/file paths
options.rationale: If modifying an existing scenario or specific Vrooli components, narrow the scope

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Specify your expected change paths

items.context: Vrooli scenarios can serve as products generating real revenue. Understanding the business model early shapes feature priorities and deployment decisions.

options.label: Internal tool / capability builder
options.rationale: Enhances Vrooli's recursive improvement loop, no direct monetization

options.label: SaaS offering
options.rationale: Deployed as a service, subscription or usage-based pricing

options.label: Open source / community tool
options.rationale: Free to use, builds ecosystem value and user base

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Specify your monetization approach

items.text: The current description ('A new test idea') is too minimal to create a meaningful implementation plan. Most plan sections are marked TBD pending answers to the decisions above. Once the core identity of this idea is established, a second workshop round can drill into architecture, data models, and implementation details.
